plan.summary:
Updates the `undici` HTTP client dependency from 6.19.2 to 7.2.0 to get the keep-alive fix.

- `package.json` moves the range from `^6.19.2` to `^7.2.0`.
- `package-lock.json` pins 7.2.0 with a new integrity hash.
- The lockfile raises the `undici` Node engine requirement from `>=18.17` to `>=20.18.1`.
plan.riskRationale: A major version bump of an HTTP client can change runtime behavior. It also drops support for Node versions below 20.18.1, which may break older runtimes.
plan.storyArc: The PR bumps undici to a new major version. The manifest states the intent and the lockfile pins the exact version and its raised Node requirement. One topic covers both.

topics.title: Upgrade undici to 7.x and raise the Node engine floor
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the undici 6 to 7 bump change for the project? Connect the new range in package.json to the pinned 7.2.0 entry and the new `>=20.18.1` Node engine in the lockfile. Verify that the project's Node version supports the new floor.
